sources.quote: 51 Pegasi, also named Helvetios, is a Sun-like star located 50.6 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Pegasus.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.2 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,663 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
